aura_damage.name: Aura damage
aura_damage.explanation: Damages nearby enemies repeatedly while the source is alive. Enemies must remain in range.

explosion.name: Death explosion
explosion.explanation: Explodes when defeated. Its burst, burn and pushback resolve from the death position.

ranged_aoe.name: Splash attack
ranged_aoe.explanation: A ranged hit also damages nearby enemies. Defense still applies where the ability specifies it.

ranged_aoe_dot.name: Burning area
ranged_aoe_dot.explanation: Applies damage over time in an area. Refreshing a burn extends its duration rather than adding an independent stack.

area_heal.name: Healing area
area_heal.explanation: Creates a healing area near a wounded ally. Only allies inside benefit, and healing cannot exceed Max HP.

backline_transit.name: Backline travel
backline_transit.explanation: Travels toward the enemy backline. Flame leaves a damaging trail; gush damages and pushes; burrow creates barriers for both armies. Immunity is defined by the unit.

aura_debuff.name: Slowing aura
aura_debuff.explanation: Nearby enemies are slowed while affected. A commander field and a unit aura have their own sources and durations.

basic_ranged.name: Ranged attack
basic_ranged.explanation: Attacks from its listed reach. Enemies can intercept projectiles; range alone does not protect against flankers.

ranged_pushback.name: Ranged pushback
ranged_pushback.explanation: Hits push enemies away if the battlefield and collisions permit. Displacement can also push enemies out of allied damage areas.

empowered_attack.name: Empowered strike
empowered_attack.explanation: A specified numbered strike deals increased damage. Attack speed changes how quickly the unit reaches that strike.

aura_heal.name: Healing aura
aura_heal.explanation: Restores nearby allies at fixed intervals while the source lives. Position and survival determine its coverage.

pull_then_melee.name: Pull and bite
pull_then_melee.explanation: Pulls an enemy toward the source, then fights in melee. A ranged class badge does not mean it stays safely behind the frontline.

death_split.name: Death spawn
death_split.explanation: Creates temporary children on death. They do not consume draft capacity and cannot split again. An active death-spawn theme can improve their attack.

ranged_aoe_slow.name: Slowing splash
ranged_aoe_slow.explanation: Slows enemy movement and attack speed in a small area. Repeated applications refresh the slow.

absorb_burst.name: Stored damage
absorb_burst.explanation: Prevents and stores part of damage after defense. Periodic bursts release it, then reset; death releases the stored amount with the unit's death multiplier.

death_damage_area.name: Death pool
death_damage_area.explanation: Explodes on death and leaves a temporary damaging area. Enemies outside the area take no pool damage.

damage_link.name: Damage link
damage_link.explanation: Links up to two enemies. Actual damage from any ally to one is shared with its partner. Shared hits cannot create another share.

relationships.title: A screen for ranged companions
relationships.text: {frontline} can screen for {ranged}. Automatic formation considers both armies; enemy flankers and pulls can still reach the backline.

relationships.title: Keep the screen standing
relationships.text: {healing} can support {frontline}. Healing depends on coverage and survival, so it is not guaranteed to reach every ally.

relationships.title: Control and damage areas
relationships.text: {control} can help {area_damage} keep enemies in reach. Pushback can also move enemies out of a burn or death pool.

relationships.title: Many attackers, one linked pair
relationships.text: {link} lets allied damage reach a linked partner too. A single marked enemy has no partner to share with.

relationships.title: Time the stored-damage release
relationships.text: {absorption} needs enemies nearby when its burst fires. Healing helps it survive, but a death burst and a periodic burst are different outcomes.
